name: Top Ramdor Systems & Computers Co. (1990) Ltd
summary: Top Ramdor Systems & Computers Co. (1990) Ltd develops and markets software products and services in the field of process management, surveys, tasks, business resources, product life management, projects, and maintenance in Israel and internationally. It also provides computerized services for the management and production of tenders, as well as services for the implementation, assimilation and training of products. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Tel Aviv, Israel.
